crates/platform-storage/Cargo.toml.before:
[package]
publish = ["crates-io"]
readme = "README.md"
include = ["src/**", "tests/**", "examples/**", "test-vectors/**", "Cargo.toml", "Cargo.lock", "README.md", "LICENSE"]
name = "age-plugin-phone-platform-storage"
description = "Private Windows filesystem boundary for age-plugin-phone"
edition.workspace = true
license.workspace = true
repository.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true
version.workspace = true

[target.'cfg(windows)'.dependencies]
thiserror.workspace = true
windows-sys = { workspace = true, features = [
    "Win32_Foundation",
    "Win32_NetworkManagement_IpHelper",
    "Win32_Security",
    "Win32_Security_Authorization",
    "Win32_Storage_FileSystem",
    "Win32_System_Threading",
] }

[lints.rust]
unsafe_op_in_unsafe_fn = "deny"

[lints.clippy]
all = "warn"
pedantic = "warn"

[target.'cfg(unix)'.dependencies]
rustix.workspace = true
thiserror.workspace = true
